summary: Ecopetrol S.A. furnished a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a long-outstanding Fuel Price Stabilization Fund (FEPC) receivable for Q3 and Q4 2025. Colombia's Ministry of Finance and Public Credit, via Resolution No. 2225 dated September 30, 2026, recognized and ordered payment of COP 683.99 billion to the Ecopetrol Group, with COP 573.108 billion allocated to Ecopetrol and COP 110.882 billion to Refinería de Cartagena (Reficar). Settlement occurred through issuance of Colombian Treasury Bonds rather than cash. The filing is a government receivable-collection and liquidity event, not a merger, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or control transaction. Watch sovereign payment execution and any secondary-market overhang from the Treasury Bond holdings.
